report.answer_text:
GPT‑5 is an AI model family that OpenAI released on August 7, 2025. It became the default in ChatGPT at launch. Its biggest change was that ChatGPT could automatically choose between a fast model for everyday questions and a deeper reasoning model, GPT‑5 Thinking, for harder tasks. (openai.com)
Its main improvements were:
Better coding and tool use. GPT‑5 was better at writing and debugging code, working with existing codebases, and using tools across multi-step tasks. (openai.com)
Stronger reasoning and image understanding. It improved on tasks involving math, science, and visual inputs such as charts and diagrams. It also improved at writing and following detailed instructions. (openai.com)
More reliable answers. OpenAI reported fewer factual errors and less tendency to agree with users just to please them. It could still make mistakes. (openai.com)
More control for developers. The API launched with GPT‑5, GPT‑5 mini, and GPT‑5 nano, plus settings for how much reasoning the model does and how detailed its answers are. (openai.com)
